shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat ../ticket.md; if test -f ../round-brief.md; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi; cat .lore/dod.md'
/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L44)) ([validated by: adds usage','](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L44), [validated by: adds usage')
s += '- Rounds without reported usage do not affect the total, and usage remains undefined when no round reports it ([validated by: counts reported rounds while leaving a turn with no reported usage undefined](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L67)).\\n'
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('## Facets\\n','## Facets\\n\\n- [x] Repair CI traceability links for both aggregate usage acceptance tests.\\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git commit -m 'Fix usage acceptance spec links'
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main --no-edit
git push origin HEAD
git status -sb"
